questions: What is equilibrium?
At equilibrium, has everything stopped moving?
What is an excited state?
When an excited state ends, does it always return to where it started?
What is resonance?
Does resonance mean something is constantly moving back and forth?
What is a force field?
If the force field goes down, can anything get through?
What does convergence mean?
Once convergence is reached, is the result guaranteed to be right?
What is temperature?
If the temperature reaches zero, has all motion stopped?
What is sampling?
If the sampling is random, does every possibility get the same chance?
What is a minimum?
Once a minimum is reached, is there nowhere lower to go?
What is a trajectory?
If a trajectory returns to where it started, has nothing changed?
What is a population?
If a population reaches zero, is it gone for good?
What is an orbital?
If an orbital is occupied, is something going around in circles?
What is spin?
If the spin is reversed, is it simply rotating the other way?
What is a bond?
If a bond breaks, do the two sides always stay apart?
What is potential?
If the potential is zero, is there no energy left?
What is a barrier?
If the barrier is low, does everything get across it?
